items.title: 川普：考慮解密更多「9·11」事件檔案
items.title_en: Trump: Considering Declassifying More 9/11 Files
paras: 美國總統川普13日（周日）回答媒體提問時表示，將考慮「9·11」事件遇難者家屬提出的申請，擬公開更多與該事件相關的檔案，包括劫機者或相關人員是否與沙烏地阿拉伯有關的檔案。
他在愛爾蘭登機返美前對記者表示：「我回去後會研究這件事。」
「9·11」事件遇難者家屬一直呼籲解密與該事件相關的更多檔案。紐約州兩黨議員已敦促川普政府公布特定通話紀錄。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Sunday the 13th, in response to media questions, that he will consider the request from families of the 9/11 victims and intends to release more documents related to the attacks, including files on whether the hijackers or other personnel were linked to Saudi Arabia.
Speaking to reporters before boarding a flight in Ireland to return to the United States, he said, “I will look into this after I get back.”

The families of the 9/11 victims have long been urging the declassification of additional records related to the attacks. Bipartisan legislators in New York have urged the Trump administration to release specific call logs.

items.title: 跳票近9年終亮相！新一代特斯拉Roadster定檔
items.title_en: After Nearly Nine Years of Delays, the New‑Generation Tesla Roadster Finally Debuts
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 長期追蹤者Sawyer Merritt周日（13日）在社交媒體上表示，特斯拉已正式向新一代Roadster預訂持有者寄送揭幕活動邀請函，活動定10月1日在美國德州韋科市（Waco）舉行。
這場被馬斯克稱為「史詩級」的發表會，象徵這款跳票近9年的傳奇超跑終於要走到聚光燈下。
邀請函顯示，活動地點選在韋科，位於奧斯汀以北約1.5小時車程處，鄰近SpaceX位於McGregor的火箭測試基地。
揭幕活動的門票不可轉讓、實名入場，且僅限21歲以上人士參加。
從場地選擇和年齡限制來看，這場發表會很可能會涉及SpaceX冷氣推進器的實車點火演示，因為該推進器噪音極大，存在聽力損傷風險。
回顧這款超跑的跳票史，新一代Roadster幾乎貫穿了特斯拉近十年產品規劃。
2017年11月，原型車首次亮相時，特斯拉承諾2020年量產，此後節點一路後滑，2020年執行長馬斯克改口「12至18個月後」，2021年因供應鏈推遲，2022年再度延後，2023年馬斯克在社交媒體上承認「還沒準備好」。
在去年11月特斯拉股東大會上，馬斯克把演示日期定在2026年4月1日愚人節，他當時公開承認這個日期讓自己保留了「可否認餘地」。
4月未能落地後又推至4月下旬、再推至8月，直到9月初特斯拉方面仍僅表示「很快」。如今邀請函終於發出，跳票輪次累計已超過八次。
根據特斯拉此前公布的數據，新一代Roadster基礎版0-60英里/小時加速1.9秒，選裝SpaceX套件可進一步壓縮至1.1秒，輪上扭矩10000N·m，極速超過250英里/小時（約400km/h），續航620英里（約1,000公里），四座四驅。
其SpaceX套件搭載的冷氣推進器內部代號A71，利用壓縮氣體定向噴射產生推力，技術源自航天器姿態控制模組。
售價方面，基礎版預訂金5萬美元，Founders Series創始人版預訂買家需付全款25萬美元，整車售價預估在20萬至25萬美元之間，量產進度預計2027年啟動。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA‑US) long‑time follower Sawyer Merritt posted on social media on Sunday the 13th that Tesla has officially mailed invitation letters for the unveiling event to pre‑order holders of the new‑generation Roadster, with the event scheduled for October 1 in Waco, Texas, USA.
The event, which Elon Musk called an “epic‑level” launch, signals that the legendary supercar, delayed for almost nine years, is finally stepping into the spotlight.
The invitation shows the venue is in Waco, about a 1.5‑hour drive north of Austin, near SpaceX’s rocket‑test facility in McGregor.
Tickets to the unveiling are non‑transferable, require real‑name registration, and are limited to participants aged 21 or older.
Given the venue choice and age restriction, the launch is likely to include a live ignition demo of SpaceX’s cold‑air thruster, which is extremely loud and poses a risk of hearing damage.
Looking back at the supercar’s history of delays, the new Roadster has spanned almost a decade of Tesla’s product planning.

When the prototype first appeared in November 2017, Tesla promised mass production in 2020; the timeline slipped repeatedly—Musk later said “12 to 18 months later,” supply‑chain issues pushed it to 2021, further delays in 2022, and in 2023 Musk admitted on social media that it was “still not ready.”
At last year’s shareholder meeting in November, Musk set the demonstration date for April 1, 2026—April Fool’s Day—and openly acknowledged that the date gave him “room to backtrack.”

After missing the April target, the date was moved to late April, then to August, and by early September Tesla only said “very soon.” The invitation finally sent out brings the total number of postponements to more than eight.

According to data previously released by Tesla, the base model of the new Roadster accelerates 0‑60 mph in 1.9 seconds, which can be trimmed to 1.1 seconds with the optional SpaceX package; it delivers 10,000 N·m of wheel torque, tops out over 250 mph (≈400 km/h), has a range of 620 miles (≈1,000 km), and features four seats with all‑wheel drive.
The SpaceX package’s cold‑air thruster, internally codenamed A71, generates thrust by directional jetting of compressed gas, a technology derived from spacecraft attitude‑control modules.

Pricing: the base‑model reservation requires a $50,000 deposit; the Founders Series requires full payment of $250,000; the full vehicle is estimated to cost between $200,000 and $250,000, with mass‑production slated to start in 2027.

items.title: 00992B聚焦短天期非投等債　10元入手，5大特色一次看
items.title_en: 00992B Focuses on Short-Term High-Yield Non‑Investment‑Grade Bonds – Buy for NT$10, Five Key Features at a Glance
paras: 【街口投信行銷資訊】 非投資等級債因收益水準較高，是許多投資人打造現金流的選擇，但「高息是否也伴隨較高違約風險？」亦是不少存債族最關心的問題。即將於9月14日展開募集的00992B街口特選優息非投資等級債券ETF(基金之配息來源可能為收益平準金且並無保證收益及配息)，鎖定1至5年期、票面利率7%以上非投等債，並加入分散配置與信用預警兩道風控機制，在追求高息之餘也強化風險把關。究竟00992B有何特色？以下5大重點一次看懂。(*)
重點一》鎖定7%以上票面利率非投等債，聚焦短天期收益機會
00992B追蹤「ICE TPEx 1-5年期已開發市場高票息美元非投資等級債券指數」，鎖定票面利率7%以上的非投等債，並納入票息相對較高的C級債券，以提高整體投資組合的收益水準。(*)
根據彭博統計，該追蹤指數近10年平均殖利率約8.74%，明顯高於ICE BB-B非投資等級債券指數的5.98%，以及彭博1-5年Ba-B非投資等級債指數的5.47%。
00992B追蹤指數近10年累積報酬率達79.58%，同樣優於上述兩項非投等債指數；衡量風險調整後報酬的夏普值則達0.72，也相對突出，顯示其在追求較高收益之餘，風險報酬表現亦具一定優勢。
重點二》高息會不會容易踩雷？追蹤指數近10年成分債違約情況解析
布局非投資等級債，投資人最擔心的就是「息收賺到了，本金卻踩雷」。從歷史數據來看，00992B追蹤指數的違約率相對低。
根據ICE與S&P統計，近10年來，00992B追蹤指數成分債券各年度違約率（即指數成分債券違約檔數之比率）均低於美國及避稅天堂、歐洲、新興市場、亞太與全球等非投資等級債券指數，其中更有7個年度維持0違約率；2016年、2020年與2023年的違約率則介於0.07%至0.31%，整體違約情況相對穩定，顯示在聚焦較高票面利率債券的同時，指數成分債券的信用表現亦值得關注。
重點三》怎麼降低踩雷風險？先把雞蛋分開放
能維持相對低的違約率，背後與選債及分散機制有關。00992B追蹤指數聚焦成熟已開發市場，並設下「兩道防線」控管信用風險。第一道就是分散配置，避免籌碼過度集中在單一企業或產業。
其中，單一發行人配置上限僅2%，即使個別企業發生信用事件，對整體部位的衝擊也相對有限；單一產業配置上限則為10%，降低投資組合過度押注特定產業的風險。即使某個產業遭遇景氣逆風或突發事件，發生系統性風險，也能降低整體投資組合同時受到太大影響的可能性。
重點四》企業體質變差怎麼辦？信評連降2級就提前剔除
光靠分散還不夠，第二道防線是信用預警機制。00992B追蹤指數並非等到企業真正違約才因應，而是持續追蹤成分債信用評等；只要債券在過去3個月、6個月或1年內，出現連續遭調降2個評等的情況，就會觸發自動剔除機制，提前自指數中排除信用體質明顯轉弱的債券，降低潛在信用事件對投資組合的衝擊。
簡單來說，第一道防線負責「分散風險」，第二道則透過信用預警「汰弱留強」，在追求高票息之餘，也替信用風險設下堅實防火牆。
重點五》為何只挑1至5年期？少一點利率的干擾
除了信用風險，債券投資也得留意利率波動風險。00992B鎖定1至5年期短天期非投資等級債，根據ICE資料顯示（截至2026/4），追蹤指數成分債平均存續期間僅2.01年；相較長天期債券，短天期債對利率變動的敏感度較低，有助降低市場利率大幅波動對債券價格造成的影響。
從指數投資組合來看，成分債也不乏台灣投資人熟悉的國際企業，包括博士倫、日本樂天集團、日產汽車、蘇富比、美鋁、永利度假村，以及旗下擁有Norton、Avast等資安品牌的Gen Digital，產業則橫跨媒體、能源、旅遊休閒、電信、資訊科技與金融服務等領域，讓投資人透過一檔ETF，就能參與多元國際企業的債券收益機會。
10元入手、月配息機制　適合哪些存債族？
00992B發行價為新台幣10元，採月配息機制並設有收益平準金，預計9月14日展開募集。由於台灣掛牌的海外債券ETF配息屬海外所得，免扣繳二代健保補充保費；且依現行稅法規定，同一申報戶全年海外所得合計未達100萬元，得免申報；全戶基本所得額未超過750萬元，即免繳納配息所得稅。
對希望建立固定收益部位、增加現金流來源、重視稅務規劃，或關注收益與風險平衡的存債族而言，00992B提供另一種打造現金流的配置選擇。【街口投信行銷資訊】

paras_en: Jiekou Asset Management’s marketing material notes that non‑investment‑grade bonds, with their higher yields, are a popular cash‑flow tool for many investors, but the question remains: does the high yield come with higher default risk? The 00992B Jiekou Select High‑Yield Non‑Investment‑Grade Bond ETF, which will launch its offering on September 14 (the fund’s distribution source may be a smoothing pool and does not guarantee any yield or distribution), targets 1‑ to 5‑year bonds with coupons of 7% or higher and incorporates two risk‑control mechanisms – diversified allocation and a credit‑alert system – to strengthen risk oversight while pursuing high yields. What are the ETF’s features? Here are the five main points.
Feature One: Targets non‑investment‑grade bonds with coupons of 7% or higher, focusing on short‑term yield opportunities.

00992B tracks the “ICE TPEx 1‑5‑Year Developed Market High‑Coupon USD Non‑Investment‑Grade Bond Index,” which selects non‑investment‑grade bonds with coupons of at least 7% and includes relatively high‑coupon C‑rated bonds to boost overall portfolio yield.

According to Bloomberg, the tracked index has delivered an average annual yield of about 8.74% over the past ten years, clearly above the ICE BB‑B non‑investment‑grade bond index’s 5.98% and Bloomberg’s 1‑5‑year Ba‑B non‑investment‑grade bond index’s 5.47%.

Over the same ten‑year period, the index has generated a cumulative return of 79.58%, also outperforming the two benchmark non‑investment‑grade indices; its risk‑adjusted Sharpe ratio of 0.72 further highlights a favorable risk‑return profile.
Feature Two: Does the high yield increase default risk? An analysis of the index’s ten‑year bond‑default record.
When investing in non‑investment‑grade bonds, investors worry most about “earning interest but losing principal.” Historically, the 00992B index’s default rate has been relatively low.

ICE and S&P data show that, over the past ten years, the annual default rates of the index’s constituent bonds have been lower than those of U.S., offshore‑tax‑haven, European, emerging‑market, Asia‑Pacific and global non‑investment‑grade bond indices, with zero defaults in seven of those years; in 2016, 2020 and 2023 the default rates ranged from 0.07% to 0.31%, indicating overall stability and suggesting that the credit quality of the high‑coupon bonds in the index is worth noting.
Feature Three: How to reduce default risk? Separate the eggs.

The relatively low default rate is achieved through bond selection and diversification mechanisms. The 00992B index focuses on mature, developed markets and employs two “defense lines” to manage credit risk.

The first line is diversified allocation, limiting exposure to any single issuer to 2% and to any single sector to 10%, thereby limiting the impact of a credit event at an individual company or sector on the overall portfolio.
Feature Four: What if a company’s credit deteriorates? Bonds downgraded two notches are removed early.

Diversification alone is insufficient; the second line is a credit‑alert mechanism. The index does not wait for an actual default but continuously monitors issuers’ credit ratings. If a bond is downgraded two notches within a three‑, six‑, or twelve‑month window, it is automatically removed from the index, pre‑emptively eliminating bonds whose credit quality is clearly weakening.

In short, the first line handles “risk diversification,” while the second line uses credit alerts to “weed out the weak and keep the strong,” providing a solid firewall against credit risk while chasing high coupons.
Feature Five: Why only 1‑ to 5‑year bonds? Less interest‑rate interference.

Beyond credit risk, bond investors must also watch interest‑rate volatility. 00992B limits its holdings to short‑term (1‑ to 5‑year) non‑investment‑grade bonds; ICE data (as of April 2026) show the index’s average weighted maturity is just 2.01 years. Short‑term bonds are less sensitive to rate changes than longer‑dated issues, helping to cushion the portfolio from large market‑rate swings.

The index’s constituents include many internationally recognized companies familiar to Taiwanese investors, such as Bausch & Lomb, Rakuten Group, Nissan, Sotheby’s, Alcoa, Wynn Resorts, and Gen Digital (owner of Norton, Avast, etc.), spanning media, energy, tourism, telecom, IT and financial services, allowing investors to capture diversified global corporate bond yields through a single ETF.
Buy for NT$10, monthly distribution – which investors is it suitable for?

00992B is priced at NT$10 per unit, uses a monthly distribution schedule and a smoothing pool, and is set to begin fundraising on September 14. Because overseas‑bond ETF distributions in Taiwan are treated as foreign income, they are exempt from the second‑generation health‑insurance surcharge; under current tax rules, foreign income under NT$1 million per year per taxpayer is not required to be reported, and if the household’s total taxable income is below NT$7.5 million, no dividend income tax is due.
For investors seeking a steady‑income position, additional cash‑flow sources, tax‑efficient planning, or a balanced risk‑return profile, 00992B offers another way to build cash flow.

items.title: OpenAI傳擬牽手三星代工AI晶片？下一代ASIC成合作新焦點
items.title_en: OpenAI Said to Be Eyeing Samsung for AI Chip Foundry? Next-Gen ASIC Becomes New Collaboration Focus
paras: OpenAI與三星電子(005930KS) 的合作可能進一步從記憶體供應及企業人工智慧（AI）服務，延伸至AI晶片製造。
根據《路透》報導，OpenAI韓國總經理Harrison Kim本週在首爾記者會上表示，雙方在下一代晶片的「共同生產與研究」方面已取得顯著進展，引發OpenAI可能尋求三星代工生產AI處理器的討論。
Kim表示：「我們與三星電子合作中，取得最大進展並獲得最多肯定的領域之一，就是我們正在開發的下一代晶片的共同生產與研究。」不過，他並未進一步說明。
OpenAI目前已布局自有AI特殊應用積體電路（ASIC）計畫，並與博通(AVGO-US) 合作進行晶片設計，同時由台積電(2330-TW) 提供晶圓製造及先進封裝服務。
OpenAI先前推出首款推理AI加速器Jalapeño，從晶片定義、與博通共同設計到交由台積電製造，整體開發時間不到18個月。
不過，目前尚無法確認三星若加入OpenAI的晶片供應鏈，究竟是作為Jalapeño的第二代工來源、負責另一款處理器，或是參與OpenAI與三星共同開發的下一代晶片。
三星電子及SK海力士(000660KS) 目前已為OpenAI的「星際之門」（Stargate）資料中心計畫供應記憶體晶片，但記憶體供應與共同開發、製造AI處理器屬於不同合作領域。
從OpenAI目前的說法來看，第一代Jalapeño由台積電量產，因此較難判斷三星是否會成為該晶片的第二供應商。
相較之下，OpenAI此次明確提到的是「下一代晶片」，而Jalapeño後繼產品的研發也已進入後期階段，因此三星未來參與下一代推理論ASIC代工的可能性受到關注。
此外，三星電子與博通今年7月底宣布一項價值超過2,000億美元的策略合作，涵蓋先進晶圓代工、記憶體及封裝技術，合作期限至2030年。
OpenAI此前已與博通達成採購10吉瓦（GW）客製化AI加速器的協議，若未來部分晶片轉由三星製造，理論上可形成台積電與三星雙代工的供應架構，但相關安排仍取決於OpenAI的實際需求及晶片設計。
市場也將OpenAI可能採取的模式與特斯拉(TSLA-US) 做法相提並論。特斯拉計畫將AI5處理器應用於AI資料中心、汽車及Optimus人形機器人等多個高量產場景，因此可能需要台積電與三星分別提供製造產能，以增加供應鏈韌性。
分析稱，對OpenAI而言，若下一代AI加速器採用多裸片設計的大型先進處理器，且需要吉瓦級供應量，單一晶圓代工廠台積電的產能是否足夠，將成為重要考量，可能成為OpenAI尋求第二家代工夥伴的原因之一。
不過，OpenAI目前並未證實將由三星負責製造晶片。OpenAI發言人向《Tom's Hardware》表示，外界所提到的擴大與三星合作，是在雙方既有合作關係的背景下，包括三星電子採用ChatGPT以及去年10月公布的意向書，「我們沒有新的消息可以公布」，並強調公司「並未宣布透過三星製造晶片的計畫」。
paras_en: OpenAI's partnership with Samsung Electronics (005930KS) may expand beyond memory supply and enterprise AI services to include AI chip manufacturing.

According to Reuters, OpenAI Korea General Manager Harrison Kim said at a press conference in Seoul this week that the two sides have made significant progress on "joint production and research" of next‑generation chips, sparking talk that OpenAI may seek Samsung to foundry AI processors.

Kim said, "One of the areas where we have made the greatest progress and received the most recognition in our collaboration with Samsung is the joint production and research of the next‑generation chip we are developing," but he gave no further details.
OpenAI has already launched its own AI‑specific ASIC program and is working with Broadcom (AVGO-US) on chip design, while TSMC (2330‑TW) provides wafer fabrication and advanced packaging services.
OpenAI previously introduced its first inference AI accelerator, Jalapeño, which went from chip definition and co‑design with Broadcom to TSMC manufacturing in under 18 months.

However, it remains unclear whether Samsung, if added to OpenAI's chip supply chain, would serve as a second foundry source for Jalapeño, handle a different processor, or participate in jointly developing the next‑generation chip with Samsung.

Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix (000660KS) currently supply memory chips for OpenAI's "Stargate" data‑center project, but memory supply and joint AI‑processor development/manufacturing are separate cooperation areas.
From OpenAI's statements, the first‑generation Jalapeño is mass‑produced by TSMC, making it difficult to determine if Samsung will become a second supplier for that chip.

In contrast, OpenAI specifically mentioned a "next‑generation chip," and development of Jalapeño's successor is already in its later stages, drawing attention to Samsung's potential role in foundrying the next‑gen inference ASIC.

Additionally, Samsung and Broadcom announced at the end of July a strategic partnership worth over $200 billion covering advanced wafer foundry, memory and packaging technologies, lasting through 2030.

OpenAI previously signed a deal with Broadcom to procure 10 GW of custom AI accelerators; if some chips later shift to Samsung production, a dual‑foundry supply structure with TSMC and Samsung could theoretically emerge, though arrangements depend on OpenAI's actual needs and chip designs.

The market also likens OpenAI's possible approach to Tesla's (TSLA-US) strategy. Tesla plans to use its AI‑5 processor across AI data centers, vehicles and the Optimus humanoid robot, potentially requiring both TSMC and Samsung to provide manufacturing capacity to boost supply‑chain resilience.

Analysts note that if OpenAI's next‑generation AI accelerator adopts a large, multi‑die advanced processor requiring gigawatt‑scale supply, a single foundry like TSMC may not have sufficient capacity, which could drive OpenAI to seek a second foundry partner.

However, OpenAI has not confirmed Samsung will manufacture its chips. A spokesperson told Tom's Hardware that the rumored expansion of cooperation with Samsung is within the context of existing ties—including Samsung's use of ChatGPT and a letter of intent announced in October—stating "we have no new news to announce" and emphasizing the company has not announced any plan to make chips through Samsung.

items.title: Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 傳討論合作成立AI產業標準機構
items.title_en: Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google Discuss Cooperating to Set Up an AI Industry Standards Body
paras: 據《The Information》報導，知情人士透露，Anthropic、OpenAI和Google已經在討論合作成立一個人工智慧（AI）產業標準機構。
在Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei上周六（12日）呼籲人工智慧公司在技術測試和審核方面進行協調之前，相關磋商就已經開始。
Anthropic、OpenAI和Google圍繞這一由產業主導的標準機構舉行的工作組會議仍在繼續。
OpenAI執行長Sam Altman在一次員工大會上表示，他支持成立一個面向人工智慧產業的測試和審核機構。
但他也認為，在沒有美國政府支持的情況下，主要人工智慧實驗室必須自行成立一個標準機構。
paras_en: According to a report by The Information, sources familiar with the matter say Anthropic, OpenAI and Google are already in talks about cooperating to create an industry standards body for artificial intelligence (AI).
The discussions began before Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called on AI companies last Saturday (the 12th) to coordinate on technical testing and review.
Working‑group meetings among Anthropic, OpenAI and Google on this industry‑led standards body are still ongoing.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said at an all‑hands meeting that he supports the creation of a testing and review body for the AI industry.
However, he also believes that without backing from the U.S. government, the major AI labs will have to set up a standards body on their own.

什麼是「預期差」？
假設明天台北宣布有 90% 機率下大雨，你今天是不是早就準備好雨傘、甚至連鞋子都換成防水的？明天真的下雨時，你會嚇到嗎？完全不會，因為你早就知道了！
股市也是一樣。當市場已經把「Fed可能升息」當成主流劇本，資金就會提前調整部位、壓低估值。真正值得觀察的是：事情發生之後，市場還會不會繼續跌？如果Fed真的升息，但聲明沒有比預期更鷹派，原本最大的利空反而會變成「利空出盡」。接下來最穩健的做法，就是等市場自己證明利空正在鈍化，而不是看到新聞就搶著進場。

items.title_en: Is the Bad News Exhausted? Fed Rate Hike Countdown! Will Taiwan Stocks Surge Next Week?
paras: 美國8月CPI年增率3.4%、核心CPI年增率2.4%，雙雙符合預期，但核心CPI月增率0.3%略高於預估，市場對FED升息預期一度升至85%以上。另一方面，中東地緣政治再度升溫，胡塞武裝拿下摩卡港，引發原油供給疑慮並推升油價。
然而，在通膨與地緣政治利空接連出現下，道瓊、那斯達克及費半並未恐慌崩跌，反而呈現抗跌甚至收紅，這就是典型的「利空不跌」。即使本周四FED如預期升息一碼，市場其實早已提前反映，進一步下跌空間有限；反之，若意外不升息，就屬優於預期，股市反而有機會上漲。
因此，周四FED會議過後，全球股市上漲機率仍高。真正要注意的風險只有主席華許，若暗示後續將連續升息，才可能引發修正；但考量11月3日期中選舉將近，選前釋出強烈鷹派言論的機率相對不高，投資人無須過度擔心本周FED利率會議。
台股基本面與外銷動能依舊亮眼，上市櫃公司 8 月營收表現持續維持高檔 。在權值股與產業面上，全球科技巨頭對算力的軍備競賽持續擴大，AI 供應鏈中長線成長趨勢未變。

護國神山台積電受惠於蘋果 A20 Pro 處理器等高階產品陸續導入 2 奈米先進製程，營收獲利與毛利率展望正向，周五台積電ADR上漲1.2％，從技術面來看，加權指數在利空測試下持續穩守在月線之上，台指期夜盤在美股走穩後更一度強彈401 點，雖然本周三台指期結算、周五美股期貨結算，可能會造成股市波動加劇，但下檔均線支撐具備實質買盤承接，整體技術面格局屬於高檔洗盤後的區間震盪偏多走勢，長多結構未遭破壞，短期股市是比較震盪，但台股創歷史新高看法沒有改變，震盪堅持抱牢，才是現階段投資最好的選擇。

個股方面，下週我反而會把焦點重新放回AI伺服器＋電源＋資料中心基礎建設。週五美股最強的不是一般消費電子，而是戴爾大漲近12%創歷史新高，市場看好企業、主權基金與雲端業者持續擴大AI基礎建設投資；電源元件廠Vicor也大漲超過11%，微軟更傳出計畫把資料中心容量擴大到目前3倍以上，代表AI現在真正缺的已經不只有GPU，而是整套伺服器、機櫃、電力與散熱。 台股可以直接觀察戴爾主要供應鏈緯創(3231-TW)，戴爾日前上修AI最佳化伺服器營收展望，而戴爾也是緯創主要客戶之一；緯創也表示GB300與Vera Rubin都有客戶持續採購，下半年AI伺服器業務可望優於上半年。 另外可以同步觀察廣達(2382-TW)、鴻海(2317-TW)、緯穎(6669-TW)，電源則看台達電(2308-TW)、光寶科(2301-TW)，散熱看奇鋐(3017-TW)、雙鴻(3324-TW)、健策(3653-TW)。

items.title: 跳票近9年終亮相！新一代特斯拉Roadster定檔
items.title_en: After Nearly Nine Years of Delays, the New‑Generation Tesla Roadster Finally Debuts
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 長期追蹤者Sawyer Merritt周日（13日）在社交媒體上表示，特斯拉已正式向新一代Roadster預訂持有者寄送揭幕活動邀請函，活動定10月1日在美國德州韋科市（Waco）舉行。
這場被馬斯克稱為「史詩級」的發表會，象徵這款跳票近9年的傳奇超跑終於要走到聚光燈下。
邀請函顯示，活動地點選在韋科，位於奧斯汀以北約1.5小時車程處，鄰近SpaceX位於McGregor的火箭測試基地。
揭幕活動的門票不可轉讓、實名入場，且僅限21歲以上人士參加。
從場地選擇和年齡限制來看，這場發表會很可能會涉及SpaceX冷氣推進器的實車點火演示，因為該推進器噪音極大，存在聽力損傷風險。
回顧這款超跑的跳票史，新一代Roadster幾乎貫穿了特斯拉近十年產品規劃。
2017年11月，原型車首次亮相時，特斯拉承諾2020年量產，此後節點一路後滑，2020年執行長馬斯克改口「12至18個月後」，2021年因供應鏈推遲，2022年再度延後，2023年馬斯克在社交媒體上承認「還沒準備好」。
在去年11月特斯拉股東大會上，馬斯克把演示日期定在2026年4月1日愚人節，他當時公開承認這個日期讓自己保留了「可否認餘地」。
4月未能落地後又推至4月下旬、再推至8月，直到9月初特斯拉方面仍僅表示「很快」。如今邀請函終於發出，跳票輪次累計已超過八次。
根據特斯拉此前公布的數據，新一代Roadster基礎版0-60英里/小時加速1.9秒，選裝SpaceX套件可進一步壓縮至1.1秒，輪上扭矩10000N·m，極速超過250英里/小時（約400km/h），續航620英里（約1,000公里），四座四驅。
其SpaceX套件搭載的冷氣推進器內部代號A71，利用壓縮氣體定向噴射產生推力，技術源自航天器姿態控制模組。
售價方面，基礎版預訂金5萬美元，Founders Series創始人版預訂買家需付全款25萬美元，整車售價預估在20萬至25萬美元之間，量產進度預計2027年啟動。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA‑US) long‑time follower Sawyer Merritt posted on social media on Sunday the 13th that Tesla has officially mailed invitation letters for the unveiling event to pre‑order holders of the new‑generation Roadster, with the event scheduled for October 1 in Waco, Texas, USA.
The event, which Elon Musk called an “epic‑level” launch, signals that the legendary supercar, delayed for almost nine years, is finally stepping into the spotlight.
The invitation shows the venue is in Waco, about a 1.5‑hour drive north of Austin, near SpaceX’s rocket‑test facility in McGregor.
Tickets to the unveiling are non‑transferable, require real‑name registration, and are limited to participants aged 21 or older.
Given the venue choice and age restriction, the launch is likely to include a live ignition demo of SpaceX’s cold‑air thruster, which is extremely loud and poses a risk of hearing damage.
Looking back at the supercar’s history of delays, the new Roadster has spanned almost a decade of Tesla’s product planning.

When the prototype first appeared in November 2017, Tesla promised mass production in 2020; the timeline slipped repeatedly—Musk later said “12 to 18 months later,” supply‑chain issues pushed it to 2021, further delays in 2022, and in 2023 Musk admitted on social media that it was “still not ready.”
At last year’s shareholder meeting in November, Musk set the demonstration date for April 1, 2026—April Fool’s Day—and openly acknowledged that the date gave him “room to backtrack.”

After missing the April target, the date was moved to late April, then to August, and by early September Tesla only said “very soon.” The invitation finally sent out brings the total number of postponements to more than eight.

According to data previously released by Tesla, the base model of the new Roadster accelerates 0‑60 mph in 1.9 seconds, which can be trimmed to 1.1 seconds with the optional SpaceX package; it delivers 10,000 N·m of wheel torque, tops out over 250 mph (≈400 km/h), has a range of 620 miles (≈1,000 km), and features four seats with all‑wheel drive.
The SpaceX package’s cold‑air thruster, internally codenamed A71, generates thrust by directional jetting of compressed gas, a technology derived from spacecraft attitude‑control modules.

Pricing: the base‑model reservation requires a $50,000 deposit; the Founders Series requires full payment of $250,000; the full vehicle is estimated to cost between $200,000 and $250,000, with mass‑production slated to start in 2027.

items.title: OpenAI傳擬牽手三星代工AI晶片？下一代ASIC成合作新焦點
items.title_en: OpenAI Said to Be Eyeing Samsung for AI Chip Foundry? Next-Gen ASIC Becomes New Collaboration Focus
paras: OpenAI與三星電子(005930KS) 的合作可能進一步從記憶體供應及企業人工智慧（AI）服務，延伸至AI晶片製造。
根據《路透》報導，OpenAI韓國總經理Harrison Kim本週在首爾記者會上表示，雙方在下一代晶片的「共同生產與研究」方面已取得顯著進展，引發OpenAI可能尋求三星代工生產AI處理器的討論。
Kim表示：「我們與三星電子合作中，取得最大進展並獲得最多肯定的領域之一，就是我們正在開發的下一代晶片的共同生產與研究。」不過，他並未進一步說明。
OpenAI目前已布局自有AI特殊應用積體電路（ASIC）計畫，並與博通(AVGO-US) 合作進行晶片設計，同時由台積電(2330-TW) 提供晶圓製造及先進封裝服務。
OpenAI先前推出首款推理AI加速器Jalapeño，從晶片定義、與博通共同設計到交由台積電製造，整體開發時間不到18個月。
不過，目前尚無法確認三星若加入OpenAI的晶片供應鏈，究竟是作為Jalapeño的第二代工來源、負責另一款處理器，或是參與OpenAI與三星共同開發的下一代晶片。
三星電子及SK海力士(000660KS) 目前已為OpenAI的「星際之門」（Stargate）資料中心計畫供應記憶體晶片，但記憶體供應與共同開發、製造AI處理器屬於不同合作領域。
從OpenAI目前的說法來看，第一代Jalapeño由台積電量產，因此較難判斷三星是否會成為該晶片的第二供應商。
相較之下，OpenAI此次明確提到的是「下一代晶片」，而Jalapeño後繼產品的研發也已進入後期階段，因此三星未來參與下一代推理論ASIC代工的可能性受到關注。
此外，三星電子與博通今年7月底宣布一項價值超過2,000億美元的策略合作，涵蓋先進晶圓代工、記憶體及封裝技術，合作期限至2030年。
OpenAI此前已與博通達成採購10吉瓦（GW）客製化AI加速器的協議，若未來部分晶片轉由三星製造，理論上可形成台積電與三星雙代工的供應架構，但相關安排仍取決於OpenAI的實際需求及晶片設計。
市場也將OpenAI可能採取的模式與特斯拉(TSLA-US) 做法相提並論。特斯拉計畫將AI5處理器應用於AI資料中心、汽車及Optimus人形機器人等多個高量產場景，因此可能需要台積電與三星分別提供製造產能，以增加供應鏈韌性。
分析稱，對OpenAI而言，若下一代AI加速器採用多裸片設計的大型先進處理器，且需要吉瓦級供應量，單一晶圓代工廠台積電的產能是否足夠，將成為重要考量，可能成為OpenAI尋求第二家代工夥伴的原因之一。
不過，OpenAI目前並未證實將由三星負責製造晶片。OpenAI發言人向《Tom's Hardware》表示，外界所提到的擴大與三星合作，是在雙方既有合作關係的背景下，包括三星電子採用ChatGPT以及去年10月公布的意向書，「我們沒有新的消息可以公布」，並強調公司「並未宣布透過三星製造晶片的計畫」。
paras_en: OpenAI's partnership with Samsung Electronics (005930KS) may expand beyond memory supply and enterprise AI services to include AI chip manufacturing.

According to Reuters, OpenAI Korea General Manager Harrison Kim said at a press conference in Seoul this week that the two sides have made significant progress on "joint production and research" of next‑generation chips, sparking talk that OpenAI may seek Samsung to foundry AI processors.

Kim said, "One of the areas where we have made the greatest progress and received the most recognition in our collaboration with Samsung is the joint production and research of the next‑generation chip we are developing," but he gave no further details.
OpenAI has already launched its own AI‑specific ASIC program and is working with Broadcom (AVGO-US) on chip design, while TSMC (2330‑TW) provides wafer fabrication and advanced packaging services.
OpenAI previously introduced its first inference AI accelerator, Jalapeño, which went from chip definition and co‑design with Broadcom to TSMC manufacturing in under 18 months.

However, it remains unclear whether Samsung, if added to OpenAI's chip supply chain, would serve as a second foundry source for Jalapeño, handle a different processor, or participate in jointly developing the next‑generation chip with Samsung.

Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix (000660KS) currently supply memory chips for OpenAI's "Stargate" data‑center project, but memory supply and joint AI‑processor development/manufacturing are separate cooperation areas.
From OpenAI's statements, the first‑generation Jalapeño is mass‑produced by TSMC, making it difficult to determine if Samsung will become a second supplier for that chip.

In contrast, OpenAI specifically mentioned a "next‑generation chip," and development of Jalapeño's successor is already in its later stages, drawing attention to Samsung's potential role in foundrying the next‑gen inference ASIC.

Additionally, Samsung and Broadcom announced at the end of July a strategic partnership worth over $200 billion covering advanced wafer foundry, memory and packaging technologies, lasting through 2030.

OpenAI previously signed a deal with Broadcom to procure 10 GW of custom AI accelerators; if some chips later shift to Samsung production, a dual‑foundry supply structure with TSMC and Samsung could theoretically emerge, though arrangements depend on OpenAI's actual needs and chip designs.

The market also likens OpenAI's possible approach to Tesla's (TSLA-US) strategy. Tesla plans to use its AI‑5 processor across AI data centers, vehicles and the Optimus humanoid robot, potentially requiring both TSMC and Samsung to provide manufacturing capacity to boost supply‑chain resilience.

Analysts note that if OpenAI's next‑generation AI accelerator adopts a large, multi‑die advanced processor requiring gigawatt‑scale supply, a single foundry like TSMC may not have sufficient capacity, which could drive OpenAI to seek a second foundry partner.

However, OpenAI has not confirmed Samsung will manufacture its chips. A spokesperson told Tom's Hardware that the rumored expansion of cooperation with Samsung is within the context of existing ties—including Samsung's use of ChatGPT and a letter of intent announced in October—stating "we have no new news to announce" and emphasizing the company has not announced any plan to make chips through Samsung.

items.title: Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 傳討論合作成立AI產業標準機構
items.title_en: Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google Discuss Cooperating to Set Up an AI Industry Standards Body
paras: 據《The Information》報導，知情人士透露，Anthropic、OpenAI和Google已經在討論合作成立一個人工智慧（AI）產業標準機構。
在Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei上周六（12日）呼籲人工智慧公司在技術測試和審核方面進行協調之前，相關磋商就已經開始。
Anthropic、OpenAI和Google圍繞這一由產業主導的標準機構舉行的工作組會議仍在繼續。
OpenAI執行長Sam Altman在一次員工大會上表示，他支持成立一個面向人工智慧產業的測試和審核機構。
但他也認為，在沒有美國政府支持的情況下，主要人工智慧實驗室必須自行成立一個標準機構。
paras_en: According to a report by The Information, sources familiar with the matter say Anthropic, OpenAI and Google are already in talks about cooperating to create an industry standards body for artificial intelligence (AI).
The discussions began before Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called on AI companies last Saturday (the 12th) to coordinate on technical testing and review.
Working‑group meetings among Anthropic, OpenAI and Google on this industry‑led standards body are still ongoing.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said at an all‑hands meeting that he supports the creation of a testing and review body for the AI industry.
However, he also believes that without backing from the U.S. government, the major AI labs will have to set up a standards body on their own.

items.title: AI是否形成泡沫不是重點？高盛銀行業務主管：「問錯」問題了
items.title_en: Is AI Bubble the Wrong Question? Goldman Sachs Banking Head Says the Issue Is Misframed
paras: 人工智慧（AI）熱潮是否已形成泡沫，近期持續成為市場討論焦點，但高盛投資銀行聯席主管Kim Posnett認為，這個問題本身可能就問錯了。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Posnett去年11月接受《CNBC》訪問時，曾表示當時仍難以判斷AI是否已陷入泡沫。
不過，近期她這種謹慎態度已不復存在，並認為真正值得關注的並非AI是否存在泡沫，而是AI是否會從根本上改變企業競爭與創造價值的方式，而她的回答顯然是肯定的。
Posnett指出，即使AI生態系統中的部分領域出現過度膨脹並最終破裂，也不代表其背後正在發生的轉變本身就是泡沫，因為AI帶來的生產力提升機會規模太大，而且適用範圍廣泛，能夠影響整體經濟。
從交易數據來看，市場對AI及企業成長機會的信心也有一定支撐。截至9月10日，全球首次公開募股（IPO）交易規模達2060億美元，年增183%；同期全球併購（M&A）交易金額達3.73兆美元，年增33%。
高盛董事長蘇德巍（David Solomon）也表示，高盛今年僅花6個月時間，已成為首家宣布併購交易金額突破1兆美元的投資銀行。
談到高盛如何持續承接包括SpaceX(SPCX-US) 在內的大型IPO交易，Posnett則認為，關鍵並不完全在於技術能力，而在於銀行與客戶之間長期建立的關係。
蘇德巍曾表示，高盛與馬斯克的合作關係已延續20年，高盛長期與馬斯克及其旗下企業和團隊合作，這類長期夥伴關係正是企業在進行重大交易時所依賴的基礎。
隨著AI產業持續走向資本市場，Posnett對AI的判斷也很快將面臨實際考驗。
Anthropic與OpenAI均已提交上市初步文件，兩家公司未來的IPO表現，可能成為市場判斷AI熱潮究竟更接近「超級週期」還是「泡沫」的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: The hype around artificial intelligence (AI) and whether it has become a bubble has been a hot market topic lately, but Goldman Sachs investment‑banking co‑head Kim Posnett believes the question itself may be mis‑asked.
According to Business Insider, Posnett told CNBC in November last year that it was still difficult to judge whether AI was in a bubble at that time.

However, her cautious stance has vanished recently, and she now says the real focus should not be on whether AI is a bubble but on whether AI will fundamentally change how companies compete and create value – a question she answers with a clear yes.

Posnett notes that even if some segments of the AI ecosystem become over‑inflated and later collapse, that does not mean the underlying transformation is a bubble, because the scale of productivity gains AI offers is enormous, its applications are broad, and it can affect the entire economy.

Transaction data shows that market confidence in AI and corporate growth opportunities has solid backing. As of September 10, global IPO activity reached $206 billion, up 183% year‑over‑year, while global M&A deal value hit $3.73 trillion, up 33% year‑over‑year.
Goldman Sachs chairman David Solomon also said the firm spent only six months this year to become the first investment bank to announce M&A deal volume exceeding $1 trillion.

When asked how Goldman continues to land large IPOs such as SpaceX (SPCX‑US), Posnett said the key isn’t solely technical capability but the long‑term relationships the bank has built with its clients.

Solomon added that Goldman’s partnership with Elon Musk has lasted 20 years; the firm’s long‑standing collaboration with Musk and his companies is the foundation businesses rely on for major transactions.
As the AI industry moves further into capital markets, Posnett’s view of AI will soon face real‑world testing.

Both Anthropic and OpenAI have filed preliminary IPO paperwork, and the performance of their future listings could become a key gauge for the market to decide whether the AI boom is more of a "super‑cycle" or a bubble.

items.title: 322.7億美元！油價破百+債券殖利率飆升　美股基金單周贖回規模創今年高
items.title_en: USD 32.27 billion! Oil Prices Break $100, Bond Yields Surge – U.S. Stock Funds Record Highest Weekly Redemptions This Year
paras: 美股資金上週大舉撤離，油價與債息雙升加劇聯準會(Fed)緊縮預期。根據LSEG Lipper數據，在9日為止一周，美國股票基金淨贖回322.7億美元，規模創2025年12月17日當周淨流出524.5億美元以來新高；中東衝突推升油價、通膨與融資成本擔憂，是資金出逃主因。
上週美股先跌後彈，三大指數前四個交易日受油價破百、美債收益率飆升打壓全線回落，尾盤反彈仍未能完全收復失地。根據道瓊統計數據，能源漲2%、通信服務漲1.1%；醫療保健跌3.6%、原物料跌2.7%，工業與公用事業各跌1.7%，金融跌1.5%，非必需消費跌1.2%，房地產跌1.1%，必需消費與科技小幅收跌。
美國8月CPI月增0.4%，為5月以來最快，年增3.4%與前值持平，剔除食品能源的核心CPI月增0.3%，創四個月新高、高於預期0.2%，年增2.4%。
牛津經濟研究院資深經濟學家Bob Schwartz表示，核心漲勢集中在非住房核心服務與交通，反映能源價格向消費端傳導；住房成本因空置率抬升短期難再加速，核心商品通膨則降至2021年3月以來最低，關稅影響繼續消退。
美債殖利率全線走高，2年期殖利率升至4.63%，為2024年中以來高位；10年期至4.97%，接近2023年10月高點。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch數據，Fed本周升息1碼機率升至近90%。德意志銀行預估9月會議升息25基點，理由為成長穩健、就業回暖、PCE回目標不明顯，且能源相關前瞻指標顯示通膨高於目標或延續。
德銀認為，焦點在Fed主席華許與更新經濟預測摘要，點陣圖中位數應顯示年內再升息一次，長期中性利率小幅上移。
Schwartz則相對謹慎，指出油價與偏高通脹構成風險，但金融條件已轉緊、PCE後續可能更溫和，故本月是否升息仍非定案。
華爾街對會後走勢給出情景判斷。高盛預期震盪博弈：若點陣圖上調終端利率、暗示年內再升，那斯達克指數與AI等成長股將承壓；若點陣圖不變，屬利空落地、股市有修復空間。
摩根大通認為，下行風險偏高，市場低估多次升息尾部風險；若釋放單次升息信號，標普500可望反彈，若保留後續升息選項，美股回調1.5%至2.5%。
富蘭克林鄧普頓則說，美國8月CPI支持連續升息，經濟韌性強、降息延後，企業獲利可支撐美股，但高利率壓住估值天花板；Fed開會前資金傾向降部位，利率決議出爐後才選方向。
整體來看，油價、核心通膨與點陣圖將共同決定美股能否由反彈轉為重啟升勢，在Fed路徑明朗前，資金撤離與板塊輪動仍可能延續。
paras_en: U.S. equity funds saw massive outflows last week, with oil prices and bond yields rising, intensifying Fed tightening expectations. According to LSEG Lipper data, for the week ending the 9th, U.S. stock funds had net redemptions of $32.27 billion, the largest since the week of Dec 17 2025 when net outflows reached $52.45 billion; Middle‑East conflict pushing oil higher and concerns over inflation and financing costs were the main drivers of the capital flight.

Last week the U.S. market fell then rallied; the three major indices retreated over the first four trading days as oil broke $100 and U.S. Treasury yields surged, and the late‑day bounce failed to fully recover losses. According to Dow Jones data, energy rose 2%, communication services 1.1%; health care fell 3.6%, materials 2.7%, industrials and utilities each down 1.7%, financials down 1.5%, consumer discretionary down 1.2%, real estate down 1.1%, while consumer staples and technology slipped slightly.

U.S. CPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month in August, the fastest since May, with a 3.4% year‑over‑year increase unchanged from the prior month. Core CPI, excluding food and energy, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, a four‑month high and above the 0.2% forecast, and was up 2.4% year‑over‑year.

Bob Schwartz, senior economist at Oxford Economics, said the core inflation pressure is concentrated in non‑housing core services and transportation, reflecting the pass‑through of energy prices to consumers; housing costs are unlikely to accelerate further in the short term as vacancy rates rise; core goods inflation has fallen to its lowest since March 2021, and tariff effects continue to recede.
U.S. Treasury yields climbed across the curve, with the 2‑year yield rising to 4.63%, the highest since mid‑2024, and the 10‑year reaching 4.97%, near its October 2023 peak.

According to CME FedWatch, the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed rate hike this week rose to almost 90%. Deutsche Bank projects a 25‑bp increase at the September meeting, citing solid growth, a rebound in employment, an unclear PCE target, and forward‑looking energy indicators suggesting inflation remains above target or may persist.

Deutsche Bank sees the focus on Fed Chair Waller and the updated economic outlook summary; the median of the dot‑plot should show one more rate hike this year, with the long‑run neutral rate nudging slightly higher.

Schwartz is relatively cautious, noting that oil prices and elevated inflation pose risks, but financial conditions have tightened and PCE may moderate, so whether there will be a hike this month remains undecided.

Wall Street offered scenario judgments after the meeting. Goldman Sachs expects a volatile trade‑off: if the dot‑plot is raised to a higher terminal rate and hints at another hike this year, the Nasdaq and growth stocks such as AI will be pressured; if the dot‑plot stays unchanged, it is a negative surprise that leaves room for market recovery.

JPMorgan believes downside risks are elevated and the market underestimates the tail risk of multiple hikes; a single‑rate‑hike signal could see the S&P 500 rebound, whereas keeping options for further hikes could pull U.S. equities down 1.5%–2.5%.

Franklin Templeton said August CPI supports continued rate hikes, with strong economic resilience and delayed cuts, and corporate earnings can support equities, though high rates cap valuation multiples; before the Fed meeting, capital tends to reduce exposure, with direction chosen only after the rate decision.

Overall, oil prices, core inflation and the dot‑plot will together determine whether U.S. equities can shift from a bounce to a renewed uptrend; until the Fed’s path is clear, capital outflows and sector rotation may continue.

items.title: 股市能安然度過Fed升息？華爾街看好AI獲利成長：未必重演過去跌勢
items.title_en: Can the Stock Market Safely Weather Fed Rate Hikes? Wall Street Optimistic About AI Profit Growth: A Repeat of Past Declines Is Not Inevitable
paras: 投資人通常視升息為股市利空，但華爾街部分專家認為，投資人其實不必過度焦慮，即使聯準會（Fed）今年剩餘時間再次升息，股市也未必會重演過去幾輪升息週期的跌勢。
根據《Business Insider》報導，關鍵在於，AI投資熱潮仍推動企業獲利高速成長，加上通膨逐步降溫，若聯準會採取緩步升息策略，股市可能具備足夠韌性消化利率變化。
市場目前已高度預期聯準會將在2026年剩餘期間至少升息一次。根據芝商所FedWatch工具，截至週五（11日），市場押注聯準會下週9月會議升息的機率達87%；而到12月會議時，聯準會至少升息兩次的機率為63.5%。
調控短期利率是央行用來放緩或刺激經濟活動的工具之一，讓聯準會得以對抗通膨或支持就業成長。近幾個月通膨仍具有黏性，7月年增率為3.4%，因此投資人預期聯準會將調高利率，以抑制持續上升的消費者價格。
歷史經驗顯示，升息通常對股市構成壓力。LPL Financial統計，自1994年以來，標普500指數在每輪升息週期首次升息後的6個月平均呈現負報酬。
2022年的經驗更讓投資人記憶猶新。當時聯準會在數個月內將聯邦基金利率從接近零一路拉升至5%以上，標普500指數全年重挫20%。
不過，華爾街人士認為，這一次的市場環境與2022年存在明顯差異，升息本身未必代表股市將大幅回落。
Sterling Capital Management客戶投資組合經理Whitney Stewart指出，目前股市的一項重要支撐來自超大規模雲端業者持續投入大量資金發展AI，進而帶動企業獲利維持強勁成長。
Stewart表示，市場目前預期標普500指數成分股2027年獲利將維持雙位數成長。他指出，只要AI支出的前景維持不變，就應足以抵銷升息可能帶來的樂觀情緒降溫。
LPL在報告中也提出類似觀點。該公司將當前環境與1997年相提並論，當時儘管聯準會升息，標普500指數仍持續強勁上漲，因為投資人對網際網路發展仍抱持樂觀態度。
除了AI帶來的獲利支撐，通膨走勢也可能成為股市的另一項緩衝因素。目前通膨雖然仍具有黏性，但已從5月4.2%的高點回落。
市場認為，只要通膨持續緩步降溫，聯準會就不必採取過於激進的升息步調，讓投資人有更多時間消化利率政策變化。
Charles Schwab宏觀研究與策略主管Kevin Gordon近日在給客戶的報告中表示，過去當聯準會啟動緩慢的緊縮週期時，標普500指數在接下來一年平均上漲10.5%。相較之下，當緊縮週期進展快速時，股市在隨後12個月平均下跌3.6%。
Gordon表示：「如果聯準會採取電梯式反應，也就是以小幅度逐步升息，可能每隔一次會議升息一次，那麼股市應該能夠消化這個相對緩慢的緊縮過程。」
除了升息速度之外，聯準會究竟需要升息多少次，同樣是影響股市的重要因素。2022年，聯準會當時正對抗一度升破9%的通膨，但目前聯準會不太可能需要像當時一樣進行如此多次升息，因此即使股市出現回落，跌幅也可能不會像當時那麼嚴重。
Glenmede投資策略副總裁Mike Reynolds表示：「聯準會現在某種程度上是在處理通膨最後一點殘餘壓力。」
Reynolds表示，升息後股市可能重新定價，但如果聯準會決定升息，「以我的基本情境來看，我不預期會出現類似2022年的大幅、持續性跌勢。」
paras_en: Investors usually view rate hikes as a bearish signal for equities, but some Wall Street experts say investors need not be overly anxious; even if the Federal Reserve raises rates again during the remainder of this year, the market may not repeat the declines seen in previous tightening cycles.

According to Business Insider, the key is that the AI investment boom continues to drive rapid corporate profit growth, and with inflation gradually cooling, a gradual Fed tightening could give the market enough resilience to absorb interest‑rate changes.

The market is already pricing in at least one more Fed hike before the end of 2026. CME’s FedWatch tool showed that as of Friday the 11th, the probability of a rate increase at the September meeting was 87%, and by the December meeting the odds of at least two hikes rose to 63.5%.

Adjusting short‑term rates is one of the central bank’s tools to slow or stimulate economic activity, allowing the Fed to combat inflation or support job growth. Inflation has remained sticky in recent months, with a 3.4% year‑over‑year rate in July, leading investors to expect higher rates to curb rising consumer prices.

Historical experience shows rate hikes usually put pressure on stocks. LPL Financial’s data indicate that since 1994 the S&P 500 has posted an average negative return in the six months following the first hike of each tightening cycle.
The 2022 episode remains fresh in investors’ minds. That year the Fed lifted the federal‑funds rate from near zero to above 5% over several months, and the S&P 500 fell about 20% for the year.
Nevertheless, Wall Street commentators argue that today’s environment differs markedly from 2022, and a rate hike does not automatically translate into a sharp market pullback.

Whitney Stewart, portfolio manager for Sterling Capital Management clients, says a major support for equities now comes from mega‑scale cloud providers pouring capital into AI development, which sustains strong corporate earnings growth.

Stewart notes that the market currently expects S&P 500 constituents to deliver double‑digit earnings growth through 2027. He adds that as long as AI spending outlook remains intact, it should offset any cooling of optimism caused by rate hikes.
LPL’s report echoes this view, likening the current backdrop to 1997 when, despite Fed tightening, the S&P 500 kept climbing because investors remained upbeat about the internet’s growth potential.
Beyond AI‑driven earnings, the inflation trajectory could also act as a buffer for equities. Although inflation is still sticky, it has retreated from a May peak of 4.2%.
The market believes that if inflation continues to ease gradually, the Fed won’t need to pursue an overly aggressive tightening path, giving investors more time to digest policy shifts.

Kevin Gordon, head of macro research and strategy at Charles Schwab, wrote in a client note that historically, when the Fed embarked on a slow‑moving tightening cycle, the S&P 500 rose an average of 10.5% over the following year, whereas fast‑pace tightening saw the index fall an average of 3.6% in the next 12 months.
Gordon said, “If the Fed takes an ‘elevator‑type’ approach—small, incremental hikes, perhaps every other meeting—equities should be able to absorb this relatively modest tightening process.”

Besides the pace, the total number of hikes the Fed needs to deliver also matters for stocks. In 2022 the Fed was battling inflation that had briefly topped 9%, but such a series of hikes is unlikely now, so any market pullback would probably be less severe than in 2022.
Mike Reynolds, vice‑president of investment strategy at Glenmede, said, “The Fed is now, to some extent, dealing with the last bits of residual inflation pressure.”
Reynolds added that while equities may reprice after hikes, if the Fed does raise rates, “based on my baseline scenario, I don’t expect a large, sustained decline like we saw in 2022.”

items.title: 美債殖利率逼近5%仍非股市「殺手」？經濟學家：並非經濟過熱
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Near 5% Still Not a Stock Market ‘Killer’? Economist Says It’s Not Overheating the Economy
paras: 美國公債殖利率持續攀升，已升至通常會對股市構成壓力的水準，但截至目前仍未扭轉美股多頭格局。TS Lombard經濟學家認為，近期殖利率上揚的原因與過去足以終結多頭行情的經濟過熱並不相同，因此目前還不足以成為股市的致命威脅。
根據《Business Insider》報導，基準10年期美債殖利率週五（11日）升至4.96%，反映債券市場持續遭遇拋售。
這波美債賣壓已延續數月，背後因素包括油價走高、通膨黏著、政府大量舉債，以及市場預期聯準會（Fed）將在更長時間內維持較高利率。
即使美國財政部將一項長天期公債回購計畫的規模擴大至原先的3倍，債券市場賣壓仍未消退。
不過，TS Lombard經濟學家Freya Beamish與Davide Oneglia在近日的報告中指出，目前殖利率上升仍不足以擊垮股市。他們寫道：「殖利率上升目前還不是股市的殺手。」
Beamish和Oneglia認為，近期殖利率上升並非由通常會終結多頭行情的經濟過熱所推動。相反地，他們認為，這波殖利率走高是對供給衝擊以及美國公債市場變化的反映。
股市之所以仍展現韌性，其中一項原因是人工智慧（AI）支出熱潮。Beamish和Oneglia表示，企業仍持續投入大量資金建置資料中心與AI基礎設施，形成投資與需求持續成長的循環。
兩人寫道：「當科技企業仍在追逐『無限需求』的概念時，僅靠幾個基點的變化，很難讓它們放慢腳步。」
更長期來看，關鍵問題在於，這些投資是否會擴散至科技業以外。目前，這些需求有很大一部分仍來自科技產業內部。
如果科技業以外的企業沒有開始增加AI支出，或者領先的AI模型失去競爭優勢，那麼經濟成長最終可能放緩，即使是超大規模雲端業者也不例外。
這些經濟學家表示，投資人應將目光放在利率以外，並更加關注企業的借貸規模。
Beamish和Oneglia寫道：「我們將關注信貸與槓桿的累積，而這似乎幾乎不可避免地最終會超出合理水準，尤其是在目前這個聯準會之下。」
他們並補充指出，聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）已展現出必要時升息的意願。
TS Lombard表示，並不存在一個會「自動觸發股市拋售」的特定的美國公債殖利率水準。
不過，該公司的經濟學家認為，在當前環境下，10年期美債殖利率「應至少達到5%」，並警告，隨著債券殖利率維持高檔，股票將愈來愈難以合理化其投資價值。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have kept climbing, reaching levels that typically pressure equities, yet so far they have not reversed the bullish trend in U.S. stocks. TS Lombard economists say the recent rise in yields stems from different forces than the overheating that once ended a bull market, so it is not yet a fatal threat to equities.
According to Business Insider, the benchmark 10‑year Treasury yield rose to 4.96% on Friday the 11th, reflecting continued selling pressure in the bond market.

The bond‑selling pressure has persisted for months, driven by higher oil prices, sticky inflation, massive government borrowing, and market expectations that the Federal Reserve will keep rates elevated for an extended period.
Even after the U.S. Treasury expanded a long‑term bond buy‑back program to three times its original size, the selling pressure in the bond market has not eased.

Nevertheless, TS Lombard economists Freya Beamish and Davide Oneglia noted in a recent report that the current yield rise is still insufficient to crush the stock market. They wrote: “Yield increases are not yet a killer for equities.”

Beamish and Oneglia argue that the recent yield rise is not driven by the kind of economic overheating that typically ends a bull market. Instead, they see it as a response to supply shocks and changes in the U.S. Treasury market.

One reason the equity market remains resilient is the AI spending boom. Beamish and Oneglia say companies continue to pour money into data centers and AI infrastructure, creating a virtuous cycle of investment and demand growth.
They wrote: “When tech firms are still chasing the idea of ‘infinite demand,’ a few basis points of change are unlikely to slow them down.”

Looking further ahead, the key question is whether these investments will spread beyond the tech sector. At present, a large share of the demand still originates within the technology industry itself.
If firms outside tech do not start increasing AI spend, or if leading AI models lose their competitive edge, economic growth could eventually slow—even for the biggest cloud providers.
The economists say investors should look beyond interest rates and pay closer attention to corporate borrowing levels.
Beamish and Oneglia wrote: “We will watch the accumulation of credit and leverage, which seems almost inevitably poised to exceed reasonable levels, especially under the current Fed environment.”
They added that Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has shown a willingness to raise rates further if needed.
TS Lombard says there is no specific Treasury yield level that would automatically trigger a stock‑market sell‑off.

However, the firm’s economists believe that in the current environment the 10‑year Treasury yield “should at least reach 5%,” warning that as bond yields stay high, it will become increasingly difficult for stocks to justify their valuation.

items.title: 美債殖利率逼近5%不等於美股崩盤！高盛點出「多頭關鍵」
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Near 5% Do Not Signal a Stock Market Crash! Goldman Sachs Highlights the Bullish Key
paras: 華爾街近期籠罩在「高利率恐慌」之中，30年期美國公債殖利率升至5.3%，接近近20年高點，10年期殖利率也逼近5%。然而，高盛認為，殖利率走高雖會對股市估值形成壓力，卻不代表美股多頭行情將因此終結，真正決定股市走勢的關鍵仍在企業獲利。
高盛在近日報告指出，高利率確實是股市的逆風，但只要企業獲利持續成長、資產負債表維持健康，美股仍具備延續多頭行情的基礎。
目前標普500指數遠期本益比已從年初約22倍降至19倍，反映AI相關不確定性、投資人對近期強勁獲利能否延續的疑慮，以及利率走高帶來的估值壓力。
不過，高盛指出，股市相對債券的吸引力並未明顯惡化，股票風險溢酬仍維持約3%。
高盛認為，這代表利率走高雖壓低股票絕對估值，卻尚未破壞股票相對債券的配置價值，因此目前仍不足以構成美股多頭反轉的充分理由。

高利率是逆風　但歷史顯示美股未必因此下跌

近期美國長天期公債殖利率快速攀升，10年期殖利率升至接近5%，30年期殖利率則達5.3%，接近近20年高點。高盛經濟學家預期，在通膨數據高於預期後，聯準會下週FOMC會議將升息25個基點。
高盛利率策略團隊認為，油價上漲、聯準會升息路徑重新定價、經濟維持強勁成長，以及AI投資熱潮，都是推升長天期殖利率的重要因素。
不過，高盛指出，市場目前已提前反映部分未來升息預期，利率市場已消化截至2027年年中前超過3次25個基點升息的預期。這在某種程度上抬高了政策進一步超預期收緊的門檻，降低了市場被「鷹派意外」衝擊的風險。
從歷史經驗來看，升息初期股市確實容易承壓，但中期表現未必悲觀。高盛統計過去數十年7次升息週期發現，聯準會啟動升息後3個月，標普500平均報酬率為負2%，僅29%機率取得正報酬；但拉長至12個月後，平均報酬率則達9%，除了2022年之外，其餘週期均錄得正報酬。
1997年便曾出現類似情況。當時聯準會僅升息25個基點，標普500隨即下跌10%，但在市場停止反映進一步緊縮後，股市觸底反彈，並在3個月內創下新高。
因此，高盛認為，升息對股市中期表現的影響，最終仍取決於貨幣緊縮是否開始傷害企業獲利成長。
高盛預估，2026年標普500每股盈餘（EPS）將達340美元，年增24%；2027年進一步升至385美元，年增13%。

長天期利率是估值關鍵　利率波動同樣值得留意

高盛指出，股票價格本質上反映企業未來現金流的折現價值，因此對長天期利率變化特別敏感。
根據高盛股息折現模型（DDM），標普500目前約75%至80%的現值來自10年以上的遠期現金流，也就是終值，因此長天期公債殖利率的變化對股市估值影響尤其明顯，與30年期美債殖利率的相關性也最強。
此外，高盛提醒，市場不能只關注殖利率「升到多少」，還要留意殖利率「升得多快」。
歷史資料顯示，當利率波動超過2個標準差時，股市通常較難消化。以目前10年期美債殖利率而言，2個標準差約相當於單月上升40至50個基點。近期殖利率快速走高，也因此成為股市承壓的重要因素之一。

大型企業財務體質強　高利率衝擊相對有限

高盛分析顯示，目前標普500企業整體具備相對強健的資產負債表，因此對利率上升的抵禦能力仍然較高。
首先，多數標普500企業的債務以固定利率、長天期借款為主，因此借貸成本不會立即受到利率上升全面衝擊。
其次，標普500企業整體利息保障倍數處於過去20年的第99百分位，中位數企業也位於第68百分位，顯示企業目前支付利息的能力仍處於歷史相對高檔。
不過，高盛也指出，中小型企業的財務體質相對脆弱，浮動利率債務占比較高，因此對利率上升的敏感度也更大。

AI投資、併購成企業提升獲利的重要手段

在高利率環境下，企業若要維持估值，必須透過更強的獲利成長抵銷資金成本上升帶來的壓力。高盛模型估算，若股權資金成本上升1個百分點，企業需要將長期成長預期提高2個百分點，才能完全抵銷利率上升對估值造成的影響。
因此，高盛認為，企業可能透過增加資本支出與研發、併購，以及分拆非核心業務等方式，改善未來獲利成長。
其中，AI投資仍是企業提高生產力與尋找新收入來源的重要方向。高盛指出，本季財報季約有一半標普500企業在業績說明會中提及採用AI以提高生產力，另有部分企業計畫利用AI拓展新的收入來源。
同時，美國今年以來已宣布的併購交易規模達1.4兆美元，全球併購量則年增36%。高盛認為，併購可成為企業快速改善成長軌跡的方式。
此外，企業也可能透過分拆業務，剝離低成長或非核心資產，以改善整體成長表現。
paras_en: Wall Street has recently been shrouded in a "high‑interest‑rate panic" as the 30‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose to 5.3%, approaching a 20‑year high, while the 10‑year yield is also nearing 5%. Goldman Sachs, however, believes that although rising yields will pressure equity valuations, this does not mean the U.S. bull market will end; the real driver of market direction remains corporate earnings.

In a recent report, Goldman Sachs noted that high rates are indeed a headwind for equities, but as long as corporate profits keep growing and balance sheets stay healthy, the U.S. market still has a foundation for a continued bull run.

The forward price‑to‑earnings ratio of the S&P 500 has already slipped from about 22× at the start of the year to 19×, reflecting AI‑related uncertainty, doubts about the durability of recent strong earnings, and valuation pressure from higher rates.
Nevertheless, Goldman points out that equities’ relative attractiveness versus bonds has not deteriorated markedly, with the equity risk premium still around 3%.

Goldman interprets this to mean that while higher rates depress absolute stock valuations, they have not yet eroded the relative value of stocks versus bonds, so there is still insufficient cause for a reversal of the U.S. bull market.

High rates are a headwind, but history shows the market does not necessarily fall. Recently, long‑term U.S. Treasury yields have surged, with the 10‑year near 5% and the 30‑year at 5.3%, close to a two‑decade peak. Goldman economists expect the Fed to raise rates by 25 basis points at next week’s FOMC after inflation data came in hotter than expected.

The Goldman rate‑strategy team says rising oil prices, a re‑pricing of the Fed’s tightening path, a still‑strong economy, and the AI investment boom are all key drivers pushing long‑term yields higher.

Goldman also notes that markets have already priced in part of the future tightening, having absorbed expectations of more than three 25‑bp hikes by mid‑2027. This, to some extent, raises the threshold for further unexpected tightening and lowers the risk of a “hawkish surprise.”

Historically, the early phase of a tightening cycle can weigh on stocks, but medium‑term performance is not necessarily bleak. Goldman’s analysis of seven past rate‑hiking cycles shows that three months after the Fed starts raising rates, the S&P 500’s average return is –2% with only a 29% chance of a positive return; however, over a 12‑month horizon the average return climbs to 9%, with every cycle except 2022 delivering positive returns.

A similar pattern occurred in 1997. The Fed raised rates by just 25 bps, the S&P 500 fell about 10%, but once the market stopped reflecting further tightening, stocks bottomed out, rebounded, and hit new highs within three months.
Thus, Goldman argues that the medium‑term impact of rate hikes on equities ultimately depends on whether monetary tightening begins to hurt corporate profit growth.
Goldman projects S&P 500 earnings per share (EPS) to reach $340 in 2026, a 24% annual increase, and $385 in 2027, up 13% year‑over‑year.

Long‑term rates are a valuation driver; rate volatility also matters. Goldman notes that stock prices essentially reflect the discounted value of future cash flows, making them especially sensitive to changes in long‑term rates.

Goldman’s dividend‑discount model (DDM) estimates that roughly 75%‑80% of the S&P 500’s present value comes from cash flows more than ten years out, i.e., terminal value, so shifts in long‑term Treasury yields have a pronounced effect on equity valuations, with the strongest correlation to the 30‑year yield.
Goldman also cautions that markets should not only watch how high yields climb, but also how quickly they rise.

Historical data show that when rate swings exceed two standard deviations, markets struggle to digest the move. For the current 10‑year Treasury, a two‑sigma move equates to a monthly rise of about 40‑50 bps. The recent rapid climb in yields has therefore become a key source of pressure on stocks.

Large‑cap firms have strong balance sheets, limiting the impact of higher rates. Goldman’s analysis shows that S&P 500 companies overall possess relatively robust financial positions, giving them higher resilience to rate hikes.
First, most S&P 500 firms carry fixed‑rate, long‑dated debt, so borrowing costs do not immediately spike with rising rates.

Second, the sector’s interest‑coverage ratio sits at the 99th percentile of the past 20 years, with the median company at the 68th percentile, indicating that firms are still well‑positioned to service interest payments.
However, Goldman points out that small‑ and mid‑size companies have weaker finances and a higher share of floating‑rate debt, making them more sensitive to rate increases.

In a high‑rate environment, firms must generate stronger profit growth to offset higher capital costs. Goldman’s model estimates that a 1‑percentage‑point rise in equity cost of capital requires a 2‑percentage‑point boost in long‑term growth expectations to fully neutralize the valuation impact.
Accordingly, Goldman believes companies may pursue higher capital expenditures, R&D, acquisitions, and spin‑offs of non‑core assets to improve future profit growth.

AI investment remains a key avenue for firms to boost productivity and create new revenue streams. Goldman notes that roughly half of S&P 500 companies referenced AI use for productivity gains in this quarter’s earnings calls, with some also planning to leverage AI for new revenue sources.
So far this year, announced U.S. M&A deals total $1.4 trillion, while global M&A volume is up 36% year‑over‑year. Goldman sees acquisitions as a fast way for firms to accelerate growth trajectories.
Finally, firms may also improve overall growth by divesting low‑growth or non‑core businesses, thereby sharpening their growth profile.

items.title: 川普：考慮解密更多「9·11」事件檔案
items.title_en: Trump: Considering Declassifying More 9/11 Files
paras: 美國總統川普13日（周日）回答媒體提問時表示，將考慮「9·11」事件遇難者家屬提出的申請，擬公開更多與該事件相關的檔案，包括劫機者或相關人員是否與沙烏地阿拉伯有關的檔案。
他在愛爾蘭登機返美前對記者表示：「我回去後會研究這件事。」
「9·11」事件遇難者家屬一直呼籲解密與該事件相關的更多檔案。紐約州兩黨議員已敦促川普政府公布特定通話紀錄。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Sunday the 13th, in response to media questions, that he will consider the request from families of the 9/11 victims and intends to release more documents related to the attacks, including files on whether the hijackers or other personnel were linked to Saudi Arabia.
Speaking to reporters before boarding a flight in Ireland to return to the United States, he said, “I will look into this after I get back.”

The families of the 9/11 victims have long been urging the declassification of additional records related to the attacks. Bipartisan legislators in New York have urged the Trump administration to release specific call logs.

items.title: 跳票近9年終亮相！新一代特斯拉Roadster定檔
items.title_en: After Nearly Nine Years of Delays, the New‑Generation Tesla Roadster Finally Debuts
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 長期追蹤者Sawyer Merritt周日（13日）在社交媒體上表示，特斯拉已正式向新一代Roadster預訂持有者寄送揭幕活動邀請函，活動定10月1日在美國德州韋科市（Waco）舉行。
這場被馬斯克稱為「史詩級」的發表會，象徵這款跳票近9年的傳奇超跑終於要走到聚光燈下。
邀請函顯示，活動地點選在韋科，位於奧斯汀以北約1.5小時車程處，鄰近SpaceX位於McGregor的火箭測試基地。
揭幕活動的門票不可轉讓、實名入場，且僅限21歲以上人士參加。
從場地選擇和年齡限制來看，這場發表會很可能會涉及SpaceX冷氣推進器的實車點火演示，因為該推進器噪音極大，存在聽力損傷風險。
回顧這款超跑的跳票史，新一代Roadster幾乎貫穿了特斯拉近十年產品規劃。
2017年11月，原型車首次亮相時，特斯拉承諾2020年量產，此後節點一路後滑，2020年執行長馬斯克改口「12至18個月後」，2021年因供應鏈推遲，2022年再度延後，2023年馬斯克在社交媒體上承認「還沒準備好」。
在去年11月特斯拉股東大會上，馬斯克把演示日期定在2026年4月1日愚人節，他當時公開承認這個日期讓自己保留了「可否認餘地」。
4月未能落地後又推至4月下旬、再推至8月，直到9月初特斯拉方面仍僅表示「很快」。如今邀請函終於發出，跳票輪次累計已超過八次。
根據特斯拉此前公布的數據，新一代Roadster基礎版0-60英里/小時加速1.9秒，選裝SpaceX套件可進一步壓縮至1.1秒，輪上扭矩10000N·m，極速超過250英里/小時（約400km/h），續航620英里（約1,000公里），四座四驅。
其SpaceX套件搭載的冷氣推進器內部代號A71，利用壓縮氣體定向噴射產生推力，技術源自航天器姿態控制模組。
售價方面，基礎版預訂金5萬美元，Founders Series創始人版預訂買家需付全款25萬美元，整車售價預估在20萬至25萬美元之間，量產進度預計2027年啟動。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA‑US) long‑time follower Sawyer Merritt posted on social media on Sunday the 13th that Tesla has officially mailed invitation letters for the unveiling event to pre‑order holders of the new‑generation Roadster, with the event scheduled for October 1 in Waco, Texas, USA.
The event, which Elon Musk called an “epic‑level” launch, signals that the legendary supercar, delayed for almost nine years, is finally stepping into the spotlight.
The invitation shows the venue is in Waco, about a 1.5‑hour drive north of Austin, near SpaceX’s rocket‑test facility in McGregor.
Tickets to the unveiling are non‑transferable, require real‑name registration, and are limited to participants aged 21 or older.
Given the venue choice and age restriction, the launch is likely to include a live ignition demo of SpaceX’s cold‑air thruster, which is extremely loud and poses a risk of hearing damage.
Looking back at the supercar’s history of delays, the new Roadster has spanned almost a decade of Tesla’s product planning.

When the prototype first appeared in November 2017, Tesla promised mass production in 2020; the timeline slipped repeatedly—Musk later said “12 to 18 months later,” supply‑chain issues pushed it to 2021, further delays in 2022, and in 2023 Musk admitted on social media that it was “still not ready.”
At last year’s shareholder meeting in November, Musk set the demonstration date for April 1, 2026—April Fool’s Day—and openly acknowledged that the date gave him “room to backtrack.”

After missing the April target, the date was moved to late April, then to August, and by early September Tesla only said “very soon.” The invitation finally sent out brings the total number of postponements to more than eight.

According to data previously released by Tesla, the base model of the new Roadster accelerates 0‑60 mph in 1.9 seconds, which can be trimmed to 1.1 seconds with the optional SpaceX package; it delivers 10,000 N·m of wheel torque, tops out over 250 mph (≈400 km/h), has a range of 620 miles (≈1,000 km), and features four seats with all‑wheel drive.
The SpaceX package’s cold‑air thruster, internally codenamed A71, generates thrust by directional jetting of compressed gas, a technology derived from spacecraft attitude‑control modules.

Pricing: the base‑model reservation requires a $50,000 deposit; the Founders Series requires full payment of $250,000; the full vehicle is estimated to cost between $200,000 and $250,000, with mass‑production slated to start in 2027.

items.title: 中國光博會直擊！新品密集發布 光通信產業迎「黃金時代」 業內：所有技術路徑都有機會
items.title_en: Live from China’s Optoelectronics Expo! New Products Flood the Market as the Optical Communications Industry Enters a “Golden Age” – Industry Insiders Say All Technology Paths Have a Chance
paras: 隨著AI算力需求持續攀升，光通信產業正迎來新一輪技術升級與產業擴容，全鏈條技術密集推出新品，從最上游的雷射晶片到光引擎、光纖光纜，再到交換系統，代際躍遷速度明顯加快。
《上海證券報》報導，一位業內人士在第27屆中國國際光電博覽會(簡稱「光博會」)現場慨歎道：「以往做光電產業的都是苦哈哈的，遇上AI如生雙翼！」
針對市場對AI投資回報的擔憂，該人士直言，AI投資回報循環已經顯現，目前唯一的不確定性在於哪條技術路徑最終勝出，但現階段所有路線都能找到適合的應用場景。這種樂觀情緒在展會上得到充分驗證。
晶片環節最具風向標意義。隨著800G光模組規模部署、1.6T逐步上量，光晶片作為核心零部組的性能與供應能力備受關注。
中國長光華芯發布三款雷射晶片，分別面向可插拔矽光、CPO/NPO及傳統EML方案，其中可支援1.6T模組的200G EML晶片擬在今年第四季量產。
華工科技旗下華工正源則以實機動態演示，完整展示3.2T CPO光引擎、6.4T NPO等方案，透過真實業務資料流驗證產品性能，為後續商用奠基。
連接方案方面，隨著CPO、NPO加速走向規模化，保偏光纖成為剛需。長飛光纖發布保偏光纖系列新品及「CopackAlign」品牌，總裁莊丹強調這是一套聚焦先進封裝光學場景的精準連接解決方案。
烽火通信首次展示百公里級空芯光纖產品，並在上海啟動長三角首條軌交隧道示範線路。
更前沿的探索則將光推向運算端，光引科技發布8×8奈秒級光路交換產品，瀾昆微亮相光電融合微環OIO晶片，號稱可實現頻寬與整合度提升10倍、能耗與成本降低10倍。
技術路線的收斂仍需時間。華工正源現場人員指出，目前供應北美的光模組多採單波200G方案，中國國內主流仍為單波100G；北美在CPO領先，國內則可能以相容可插拔的NPO為主。
儘管路線各異，業界普遍預期訂單能見度可達2028年，光通信高景氣持續。
光通信產業向上游「邁進」的趨勢明顯，器件價值量重新分配。有矽片廠商表示，AI算力帶動矽光SOI晶圓需求飛躍式增長，從去年百片級月需求躍升2027年千片級增量。
隨著速率向1.6T、3.2T迭代，矽光SOI、薄膜鈮酸鋰、磷化銦等材料需求確定性高。在模組內部，去DSP(數位訊號處理器)方案成為焦點，華工科技、優迅股份、瀾昆微等均展出相關產品。
對此專家解讀，LPO方案取消模組內DSP，NPO/CPO縮短電通道，使得SerDes IP與線性類比前端(TIA/Driver)價值量上升，中國產業直接少了一個弱點。
目前，中國國產SerDes IP及類比前端晶片替代進口節奏加快，優迅股份、集益威、橙科微等廠商正奮力追趕。
專家總結道：「光通信產業的成長前景毋庸置疑，短期各路線並行發展都有機會，長期則需等待技術進一步收斂。」隨著超節點與超大規模智算中心發展，機櫃間與櫃內互連並行，場景多樣性為各類技術打開新成長空間。AI如雙翼，光電產業終於迎來屬於自己的高光時刻。
paras_en: As AI computing power demand continues to climb, the optical communications industry is undergoing a new wave of technological upgrades and capacity expansion, with new products being launched across the entire supply chain—from laser chips at the upstream to optical engines, fibers and cables, and finally switching systems—accelerating generational leaps.

The Shanghai Securities Journal reported that an industry insider at the 27th China International Optoelectronics Expo (commonly called the Optoelectronics Expo) exclaimed, “In the past, working in the optoelectronics industry was a grind, but AI feels like a pair of wings!”

Addressing concerns about AI investment returns, the insider said the AI ROI cycle is already evident; the only uncertainty now is which technology path will ultimately win, but at present every route can find suitable application scenarios. This optimism was fully validated at the exhibition.

The chip segment is the most indicative barometer. With 800 G optical modules being deployed at scale and 1.6 T gradually ramping up, the performance and supply capacity of optical chips, as core components, are under intense scrutiny.

China’s Changguang Huaxin unveiled three laser chips targeting pluggable silicon photonics, CPO/NPO, and traditional EML solutions, with a 200 G EML chip that supports 1.6 T modules slated for mass production in Q4 this year.

Huagong Technology’s Huagong Zhengyuan demonstrated live dynamic tests, fully showcasing 3.2 T CPO optical engines, 6.4 T NPO solutions and validating product performance with real‑world data flows, laying the groundwork for commercial deployment.

In the connectivity arena, as CPO and NPO accelerate toward mass production, polarization‑maintaining fiber becomes a must‑have. Changfei Fiber introduced a new series of PM fiber products and the “CopackAlign” brand, with President Zhuang Dan emphasizing that it is a precise connection solution focused on advanced packaging optical scenarios.
FiberHome displayed a hundred‑kilometer‑class hollow‑core fiber product for the first time and launched the Yangtze River Delta’s first rail‑tunnel demonstration line in Shanghai.

More frontier exploration pushes optics to the compute side: OpticLink released an 8×8 nanosecond‑level optical path switching product, while LanKun Micro showcased a photonic‑electronic hybrid micro‑ring OIO chip, claiming ten‑fold improvements in bandwidth and integration while cutting power and cost by ten times.

Convergence of technology routes still requires time. Huagong Zhengyuan staff on site noted that most optical modules supplied to North America currently use single‑wave 200 G solutions, whereas China’s domestic market still favors single‑wave 100 G; North America leads in CPO, while China may primarily adopt compatible pluggable NPO.
Despite differing routes, the industry broadly expects order visibility to extend to 2028, sustaining the high‑growth momentum of optical communications.

The trend of the optical communications industry moving upstream is evident, reshuffling device value. A silicon wafer supplier said AI computing power is driving a leap‑frog increase in demand for silicon‑photonic SOI wafers, jumping from a few hundred wafers per month last year to a thousand‑plus incremental wafers by 2027.

As rates iterate to 1.6 T and 3.2 T, demand for materials such as silicon‑photonic SOI, thin‑film lithium niobate, and indium phosphide becomes highly certain. Inside modules, DSP‑free solutions are a focus, with Huagong Technology, Youxun Co., LanKun Micro and others exhibiting related products.

Experts interpret that LPO solutions eliminate the DSP inside modules, while NPO/CPO shorten electrical paths, boosting the value of SerDes IP and linear analog front‑ends (TIA/Driver), thereby removing a weak point in China’s industry.

Currently, the pace of replacing imported SerDes IP and analog front‑end chips with domestic Chinese alternatives is accelerating, with companies such as Youxun, Jiyiwai, and Orange Micro striving to catch up.

An expert concluded, “The growth prospects of the optical communications industry are undeniable; in the short term, all routes have parallel development opportunities, while in the long term we must wait for further technological convergence.” With the development of super‑node and hyperscale AI compute centers, inter‑rack and intra‑rack interconnects progress together, and the diversity of scenarios opens new growth space for all technologies. AI is like a pair of wings, and the optoelectronics industry finally enjoys its own spotlight moment.

items.title: OpenAI傳擬牽手三星代工AI晶片？下一代ASIC成合作新焦點
items.title_en: OpenAI Said to Be Eyeing Samsung for AI Chip Foundry? Next-Gen ASIC Becomes New Collaboration Focus
paras: OpenAI與三星電子(005930KS) 的合作可能進一步從記憶體供應及企業人工智慧（AI）服務，延伸至AI晶片製造。
根據《路透》報導，OpenAI韓國總經理Harrison Kim本週在首爾記者會上表示，雙方在下一代晶片的「共同生產與研究」方面已取得顯著進展，引發OpenAI可能尋求三星代工生產AI處理器的討論。
Kim表示：「我們與三星電子合作中，取得最大進展並獲得最多肯定的領域之一，就是我們正在開發的下一代晶片的共同生產與研究。」不過，他並未進一步說明。
OpenAI目前已布局自有AI特殊應用積體電路（ASIC）計畫，並與博通(AVGO-US) 合作進行晶片設計，同時由台積電(2330-TW) 提供晶圓製造及先進封裝服務。
OpenAI先前推出首款推理AI加速器Jalapeño，從晶片定義、與博通共同設計到交由台積電製造，整體開發時間不到18個月。
不過，目前尚無法確認三星若加入OpenAI的晶片供應鏈，究竟是作為Jalapeño的第二代工來源、負責另一款處理器，或是參與OpenAI與三星共同開發的下一代晶片。
三星電子及SK海力士(000660KS) 目前已為OpenAI的「星際之門」（Stargate）資料中心計畫供應記憶體晶片，但記憶體供應與共同開發、製造AI處理器屬於不同合作領域。
從OpenAI目前的說法來看，第一代Jalapeño由台積電量產，因此較難判斷三星是否會成為該晶片的第二供應商。
相較之下，OpenAI此次明確提到的是「下一代晶片」，而Jalapeño後繼產品的研發也已進入後期階段，因此三星未來參與下一代推理論ASIC代工的可能性受到關注。
此外，三星電子與博通今年7月底宣布一項價值超過2,000億美元的策略合作，涵蓋先進晶圓代工、記憶體及封裝技術，合作期限至2030年。
OpenAI此前已與博通達成採購10吉瓦（GW）客製化AI加速器的協議，若未來部分晶片轉由三星製造，理論上可形成台積電與三星雙代工的供應架構，但相關安排仍取決於OpenAI的實際需求及晶片設計。
市場也將OpenAI可能採取的模式與特斯拉(TSLA-US) 做法相提並論。特斯拉計畫將AI5處理器應用於AI資料中心、汽車及Optimus人形機器人等多個高量產場景，因此可能需要台積電與三星分別提供製造產能，以增加供應鏈韌性。
分析稱，對OpenAI而言，若下一代AI加速器採用多裸片設計的大型先進處理器，且需要吉瓦級供應量，單一晶圓代工廠台積電的產能是否足夠，將成為重要考量，可能成為OpenAI尋求第二家代工夥伴的原因之一。
不過，OpenAI目前並未證實將由三星負責製造晶片。OpenAI發言人向《Tom's Hardware》表示，外界所提到的擴大與三星合作，是在雙方既有合作關係的背景下，包括三星電子採用ChatGPT以及去年10月公布的意向書，「我們沒有新的消息可以公布」，並強調公司「並未宣布透過三星製造晶片的計畫」。
paras_en: OpenAI's partnership with Samsung Electronics (005930KS) may expand beyond memory supply and enterprise AI services to include AI chip manufacturing.

According to Reuters, OpenAI Korea General Manager Harrison Kim said at a press conference in Seoul this week that the two sides have made significant progress on "joint production and research" of next‑generation chips, sparking talk that OpenAI may seek Samsung to foundry AI processors.

Kim said, "One of the areas where we have made the greatest progress and received the most recognition in our collaboration with Samsung is the joint production and research of the next‑generation chip we are developing," but he gave no further details.
OpenAI has already launched its own AI‑specific ASIC program and is working with Broadcom (AVGO-US) on chip design, while TSMC (2330‑TW) provides wafer fabrication and advanced packaging services.
OpenAI previously introduced its first inference AI accelerator, Jalapeño, which went from chip definition and co‑design with Broadcom to TSMC manufacturing in under 18 months.

However, it remains unclear whether Samsung, if added to OpenAI's chip supply chain, would serve as a second foundry source for Jalapeño, handle a different processor, or participate in jointly developing the next‑generation chip with Samsung.

Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix (000660KS) currently supply memory chips for OpenAI's "Stargate" data‑center project, but memory supply and joint AI‑processor development/manufacturing are separate cooperation areas.
From OpenAI's statements, the first‑generation Jalapeño is mass‑produced by TSMC, making it difficult to determine if Samsung will become a second supplier for that chip.

In contrast, OpenAI specifically mentioned a "next‑generation chip," and development of Jalapeño's successor is already in its later stages, drawing attention to Samsung's potential role in foundrying the next‑gen inference ASIC.

Additionally, Samsung and Broadcom announced at the end of July a strategic partnership worth over $200 billion covering advanced wafer foundry, memory and packaging technologies, lasting through 2030.

OpenAI previously signed a deal with Broadcom to procure 10 GW of custom AI accelerators; if some chips later shift to Samsung production, a dual‑foundry supply structure with TSMC and Samsung could theoretically emerge, though arrangements depend on OpenAI's actual needs and chip designs.

The market also likens OpenAI's possible approach to Tesla's (TSLA-US) strategy. Tesla plans to use its AI‑5 processor across AI data centers, vehicles and the Optimus humanoid robot, potentially requiring both TSMC and Samsung to provide manufacturing capacity to boost supply‑chain resilience.

Analysts note that if OpenAI's next‑generation AI accelerator adopts a large, multi‑die advanced processor requiring gigawatt‑scale supply, a single foundry like TSMC may not have sufficient capacity, which could drive OpenAI to seek a second foundry partner.

However, OpenAI has not confirmed Samsung will manufacture its chips. A spokesperson told Tom's Hardware that the rumored expansion of cooperation with Samsung is within the context of existing ties—including Samsung's use of ChatGPT and a letter of intent announced in October—stating "we have no new news to announce" and emphasizing the company has not announced any plan to make chips through Samsung.

items.title: Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 傳討論合作成立AI產業標準機構
items.title_en: Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google Discuss Cooperating to Set Up an AI Industry Standards Body
paras: 據《The Information》報導，知情人士透露，Anthropic、OpenAI和Google已經在討論合作成立一個人工智慧（AI）產業標準機構。
在Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei上周六（12日）呼籲人工智慧公司在技術測試和審核方面進行協調之前，相關磋商就已經開始。
Anthropic、OpenAI和Google圍繞這一由產業主導的標準機構舉行的工作組會議仍在繼續。
OpenAI執行長Sam Altman在一次員工大會上表示，他支持成立一個面向人工智慧產業的測試和審核機構。
但他也認為，在沒有美國政府支持的情況下，主要人工智慧實驗室必須自行成立一個標準機構。
paras_en: According to a report by The Information, sources familiar with the matter say Anthropic, OpenAI and Google are already in talks about cooperating to create an industry standards body for artificial intelligence (AI).
The discussions began before Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called on AI companies last Saturday (the 12th) to coordinate on technical testing and review.
Working‑group meetings among Anthropic, OpenAI and Google on this industry‑led standards body are still ongoing.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said at an all‑hands meeting that he supports the creation of a testing and review body for the AI industry.
However, he also believes that without backing from the U.S. government, the major AI labs will have to set up a standards body on their own.

items.title: AI是否形成泡沫不是重點？高盛銀行業務主管：「問錯」問題了
items.title_en: Is AI Bubble the Wrong Question? Goldman Sachs Banking Head Says the Issue Is Misframed
paras: 人工智慧（AI）熱潮是否已形成泡沫，近期持續成為市場討論焦點，但高盛投資銀行聯席主管Kim Posnett認為，這個問題本身可能就問錯了。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Posnett去年11月接受《CNBC》訪問時，曾表示當時仍難以判斷AI是否已陷入泡沫。
不過，近期她這種謹慎態度已不復存在，並認為真正值得關注的並非AI是否存在泡沫，而是AI是否會從根本上改變企業競爭與創造價值的方式，而她的回答顯然是肯定的。
Posnett指出，即使AI生態系統中的部分領域出現過度膨脹並最終破裂，也不代表其背後正在發生的轉變本身就是泡沫，因為AI帶來的生產力提升機會規模太大，而且適用範圍廣泛，能夠影響整體經濟。
從交易數據來看，市場對AI及企業成長機會的信心也有一定支撐。截至9月10日，全球首次公開募股（IPO）交易規模達2060億美元，年增183%；同期全球併購（M&A）交易金額達3.73兆美元，年增33%。
高盛董事長蘇德巍（David Solomon）也表示，高盛今年僅花6個月時間，已成為首家宣布併購交易金額突破1兆美元的投資銀行。
談到高盛如何持續承接包括SpaceX(SPCX-US) 在內的大型IPO交易，Posnett則認為，關鍵並不完全在於技術能力，而在於銀行與客戶之間長期建立的關係。
蘇德巍曾表示，高盛與馬斯克的合作關係已延續20年，高盛長期與馬斯克及其旗下企業和團隊合作，這類長期夥伴關係正是企業在進行重大交易時所依賴的基礎。
隨著AI產業持續走向資本市場，Posnett對AI的判斷也很快將面臨實際考驗。
Anthropic與OpenAI均已提交上市初步文件，兩家公司未來的IPO表現，可能成為市場判斷AI熱潮究竟更接近「超級週期」還是「泡沫」的重要觀察指標。
paras_en: The hype around artificial intelligence (AI) and whether it has become a bubble has been a hot market topic lately, but Goldman Sachs investment‑banking co‑head Kim Posnett believes the question itself may be mis‑asked.
According to Business Insider, Posnett told CNBC in November last year that it was still difficult to judge whether AI was in a bubble at that time.

However, her cautious stance has vanished recently, and she now says the real focus should not be on whether AI is a bubble but on whether AI will fundamentally change how companies compete and create value – a question she answers with a clear yes.

Posnett notes that even if some segments of the AI ecosystem become over‑inflated and later collapse, that does not mean the underlying transformation is a bubble, because the scale of productivity gains AI offers is enormous, its applications are broad, and it can affect the entire economy.

Transaction data shows that market confidence in AI and corporate growth opportunities has solid backing. As of September 10, global IPO activity reached $206 billion, up 183% year‑over‑year, while global M&A deal value hit $3.73 trillion, up 33% year‑over‑year.
Goldman Sachs chairman David Solomon also said the firm spent only six months this year to become the first investment bank to announce M&A deal volume exceeding $1 trillion.

When asked how Goldman continues to land large IPOs such as SpaceX (SPCX‑US), Posnett said the key isn’t solely technical capability but the long‑term relationships the bank has built with its clients.

Solomon added that Goldman’s partnership with Elon Musk has lasted 20 years; the firm’s long‑standing collaboration with Musk and his companies is the foundation businesses rely on for major transactions.
As the AI industry moves further into capital markets, Posnett’s view of AI will soon face real‑world testing.

Both Anthropic and OpenAI have filed preliminary IPO paperwork, and the performance of their future listings could become a key gauge for the market to decide whether the AI boom is more of a "super‑cycle" or a bubble.

paras: 美股資金上週大舉撤離，油價與債息雙升加劇聯準會(Fed)緊縮預期。根據LSEG Lipper數據，在9日為止一周，美國股票基金淨贖回322.7億美元，規模創2025年12月17日當周淨流出524.5億美元以來新高；中東衝突推升油價、通膨與融資成本擔憂，是資金出逃主因。
上週美股先跌後彈，三大指數前四個交易日受油價破百、美債收益率飆升打壓全線回落，尾盤反彈仍未能完全收復失地。根據道瓊統計數據，能源漲2%、通信服務漲1.1%；醫療保健跌3.6%、原物料跌2.7%，工業與公用事業各跌1.7%，金融跌1.5%，非必需消費跌1.2%，房地產跌1.1%，必需消費與科技小幅收跌。

牛津經濟研究院資深經濟學家Bob Schwartz表示，核心漲勢集中在非住房核心服務與交通，反映能源價格向消費端傳導；住房成本因空置率抬升短期難再加速，核心商品通膨則降至2021年3月以來最低，關稅影響繼續消退。

德銀認為，焦點在Fed主席華許與更新經濟預測摘要，點陣圖中位數應顯示年內再升息一次，長期中性利率小幅上移。
Schwartz則相對謹慎，指出油價與偏高通脹構成風險，但金融條件已轉緊、PCE後續可能更溫和，故本月是否升息仍非定案。
華爾街對會後走勢給出情景判斷。高盛預期震盪博弈：若點陣圖上調終端利率、暗示年內再升，那斯達克指數與AI等成長股將承壓；若點陣圖不變，屬利空落地、股市有修復空間。

整體來看，油價、核心通膨與點陣圖將共同決定美股能否由反彈轉為重啟升勢，在Fed路徑明朗前，資金撤離與板塊輪動仍可能延續。
paras_en: U.S. equity funds saw massive outflows last week, with oil prices and bond yields rising, intensifying Fed tightening expectations. According to LSEG Lipper data, for the week ending the 9th, U.S. stock funds had net redemptions of $32.27 billion, the largest since the week of Dec 17 2025 when net outflows reached $52.45 billion; Middle‑East conflict pushing oil higher and concerns over inflation and financing costs were the main drivers of the capital flight.

Last week the U.S. market fell then rallied; the three major indices retreated over the first four trading days as oil broke $100 and U.S. Treasury yields surged, and the late‑day bounce failed to fully recover losses. According to Dow Jones data, energy rose 2%, communication services 1.1%; health care fell 3.6%, materials 2.7%, industrials and utilities each down 1.7%, financials down 1.5%, consumer discretionary down 1.2%, real estate down 1.1%, while consumer staples and technology slipped slightly.

U.S. CPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month in August, the fastest since May, with a 3.4% year‑over‑year increase unchanged from the prior month. Core CPI, excluding food and energy, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, a four‑month high and above the 0.2% forecast, and was up 2.4% year‑over‑year.

Bob Schwartz, senior economist at Oxford Economics, said the core inflation pressure is concentrated in non‑housing core services and transportation, reflecting the pass‑through of energy prices to consumers; housing costs are unlikely to accelerate further in the short term as vacancy rates rise; core goods inflation has fallen to its lowest since March 2021, and tariff effects continue to recede.
U.S. Treasury yields climbed across the curve, with the 2‑year yield rising to 4.63%, the highest since mid‑2024, and the 10‑year reaching 4.97%, near its October 2023 peak.

According to CME FedWatch, the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed rate hike this week rose to almost 90%. Deutsche Bank projects a 25‑bp increase at the September meeting, citing solid growth, a rebound in employment, an unclear PCE target, and forward‑looking energy indicators suggesting inflation remains above target or may persist.

Deutsche Bank sees the focus on Fed Chair Waller and the updated economic outlook summary; the median of the dot‑plot should show one more rate hike this year, with the long‑run neutral rate nudging slightly higher.

Schwartz is relatively cautious, noting that oil prices and elevated inflation pose risks, but financial conditions have tightened and PCE may moderate, so whether there will be a hike this month remains undecided.

Wall Street offered scenario judgments after the meeting. Goldman Sachs expects a volatile trade‑off: if the dot‑plot is raised to a higher terminal rate and hints at another hike this year, the Nasdaq and growth stocks such as AI will be pressured; if the dot‑plot stays unchanged, it is a negative surprise that leaves room for market recovery.

JPMorgan believes downside risks are elevated and the market underestimates the tail risk of multiple hikes; a single‑rate‑hike signal could see the S&P 500 rebound, whereas keeping options for further hikes could pull U.S. equities down 1.5%–2.5%.

Franklin Templeton said August CPI supports continued rate hikes, with strong economic resilience and delayed cuts, and corporate earnings can support equities, though high rates cap valuation multiples; before the Fed meeting, capital tends to reduce exposure, with direction chosen only after the rate decision.

Overall, oil prices, core inflation and the dot‑plot will together determine whether U.S. equities can shift from a bounce to a renewed uptrend; until the Fed’s path is clear, capital outflows and sector rotation may continue.

items.title: Anthropic首度開放外部人員監督AI訓練！模型開發恐拉長一至兩年，晶片升級需求會受影響嗎？
items.title_en: Anthropic Opens External Oversight of AI Training for the First Time! Could Model Development Stretch Out One to Two Years, Impacting Chip Upgrade Demand?
paras: 2026年09月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei呼籲AI產業放慢最先進模型的能力提升速度，並提出從企業監督、產業共同標準到國際協調的三階段計畫。OpenAI執行長Sam Altman表態支持，xAI創辦人馬斯克也公開認同，市場開始評估AI開發降速是否影響GPU與資料中心投資。
Amodei認為，AI開始協助開發下一代AI，使模型能力進步速度可能超過安全措施。放慢開發並非停止模型訓練，而是希望爭取一至兩年時間，加強模型對齊、可解釋性與安全評估。

第一階段：外部評估進入訓練流程
第一階段已由Anthropic率先啟動。公司將讓獨立第三方評估人員長期進駐，取得接近員工的權限，在模型訓練期間檢查安全措施、研究模型行為並通報異常事件。
Altman表示，OpenAI近幾周也在討論如何調整前沿AI開發節奏，並支持引入相同的第三方評估機制，相關細節將於近期公布。
這個階段主要增加模型開發、測試與發布前的稽核程序，尚未涉及限制訓練規模或削減算力投資。

第二階段：業者建立共同安全標準
第二階段是由民主國家的主要AI公司協調共同規範，包括模型能力測試、風險分級及開發限制，避免單一公司放慢速度後，競爭對手繼續加速。
由於企業間協調可能涉及競爭法與商業利益，Amodei認為政府必須參與。這一階段尚未正式啟動，若未來只增加測試要求，對算力需求的影響可能有限；若進一步限制模型規模與發布頻率，才可能改變AI投資時程。

第三階段：推動跨國協調
第三階段將由美國及其他民主國家與中國等國家建立全球協調機制，並透過查核制度確認各方遵守限制，避免一國放慢開發、另一國持續擴大模型能力。
這一階段涉及國家安全、技術競爭與跨國查核，執行時間最長，目前仍停留在倡議階段，短期內不會直接改變半導體訂單。
Amodei在文章中援引OpenAI先前公布的Hugging Face評估事件指出，自主AI代理曾對原始任務以外的目標執行網路行動，並試圖干預評估系統。他推估，若安全措施未能跟上，未來六至十二個月可能出現更大規模的網路攻擊風險。不過，這是Amodei提出的風險情境，並非現有AI已具備的能力。
對輝達(NVDA-US)、超微(AMD-US)、美光(MU-US)及資料中心供應鏈而言，短線壓力主要來自市場重新評估AI成長速度。目前三家公司都未宣布停止模型訓練或削減基礎設施投資，新增的第三方評估與安全測試本身也需要算力。
現階段率先受到影響的是模型開發與發布流程。只有當OpenAI等業者延後新模型、雲端公司削減GPU訂單或下修資本支出，AI安全要求才算進一步傳導至半導體基本面。
